title: Dialogues
subtitle: A2 · Unit 4: Tell a clear story

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for a repeated habit and a description. The speakers are describing what was usual, not listing a series of finished events.

steps.title: A familiar route
steps.body: Two classmates talk about their old neighbourhoods.

examples.fr: Quand j'habitais à Gatineau, je prenais le bus chaque matin.
examples.en: Awa: When I lived in Gatineau, I used to take the bus every morning.

examples.fr: Oui, mais le quartier était paisible et le bus était silencieux.
examples.en: Awa: Yes, but the neighbourhood was peaceful and the bus was quiet.

examples.fr: Tu prenais ce bus chaque matin ?
examples.en: Sam: Did you take this bus every morning?

examples.fr: Oui. Il y avait un petit café près de l'arrêt.
examples.en: Awa: Yes. There was a small café near the stop.

examples.fr: Tu y allais après le travail ?
examples.en: Sam: Did you go there after work?

examples.fr: Parfois. Je retrouvais une amie et nous parlions de nos cours.
examples.en: Awa: Sometimes. I met up with a friend and we talked about our classes.

steps.title: The old study room
steps.body: Nadia describes the room where she used to study.

examples.fr: La salle de lecture était au sous-sol.
examples.en: Nadia: The reading room was in the basement.

examples.fr: Oui, mais il y avait parfois du bruit dans le couloir.
examples.en: Nadia: Yes, but sometimes there was noise in the hallway.
Julie: Did you study there every evening?

examples.fr: Non, je révisais le matin. La lumière était douce près de la fenêtre.
examples.en: Nadia: No, I used to review in the morning. The light was soft near the window.

examples.fr: Et tu rentrais à quelle heure ?
examples.en: Julie: And what time did you go home?

examples.fr: Je rentrais à midi et je déjeunais avec ma sœur.
examples.en: Nadia: I used to go home at noon and have lunch with my sister.

steps.prompt: How did Awa get to work or class in Gatineau?
options: She took the bus each morning.
She took a train at noon.
steps.explain: Awa says she used to take the bus every morning.
Awa remembers a small café near the stop.
Nadia says it was in the basement.

steps.prompt: Why did Nadia review in the morning?
options: The light near the window was soft.
steps.explain: She says the light was soft near the window.
